dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds several expert‑level nuggets (e.g., tunnel‑options are immutable after creation, Accelerate:true only at creation, recent feature timeline, exact DH groups and lifetimes) that a baseline model would not enumerate, but still restates many standard AWS docs, so not a full 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific procedural flow (CGW → VPG/TGW → VPN → routing → tunnel options → verification) and concrete CLI sequences, yet a few steps are generic "verify" actions without AWS‑unique nuance, costing one point.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete pitfalls and reasons (e.g., immutable tunnel options, acceleration post‑creation), yet a few items lack explicit "why" explanations (e.g., why Global Accelerator cannot be added later is only implied).

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description, triggers, activation keywords, and exact output contract are all present and unambiguous, enabling reliable invocation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (high‑level overview → decision tree → NEVER list → step‑by‑step), but the skill is dense; some readers may experience cognitive overload before reaching the concise checklist, losing two points.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (VPN creation) are tightly constrained by a strict output contract and NEVER rules, while exploratory sections (heuristics) are free. One point is lost because the skill does not explicitly flag environment safety (e.g., prod vs dev) for the creation step.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (mindset → decision tree → anti‑patterns → procedural steps), but the ordering of sections is slightly ad‑hoc, preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete CLI commands, decision tree, checklist template, and error‑handling guidance, enabling an agent to act. Missing explicit handling for permission‑related failures (e.g., missing IAM rights for TGW attachment) and no fallback example for partial configurations, so two points are deducted.
